base_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production pixel-art status portrait for a fantasy tactical RPG. Primary request: an anonymous helmeted PHANTOM, not a living named character.
Native design target is exactly48x48 logical pixels, displayed at48x48 in game and144x144 in a phone-layout capture. Design on that coarse48x48 grid; render as a clean enlarged pixel sprite. Use visible large square pixel clusters, hard stepped edges, only20-24 flat colors, at most3 shades per material. Not a detailed painting shrunk down, no dithering/noise, no gradients, no anti-aliasing.
Composition: a single bust fills the square, three-quarter view facing slightly left, helmet fully visible with2logical pixels clear margin above; chest and shoulder bases meet lower edge. No text, labels, frame, grid or extra objects.
Unified phantom identity: completely hidden anonymous face behind a deep navy-black visor, only two tiny dim cyan eye glints; NO visible skin, NO hair, NO human facial features. Muted blue-grey steel, desaturated pale sage/cyan rim highlights, midnight teal neck wraps. Tangible silhouette with restrained spectral mood, no luminous haze or transparent blur. Background uniformly flat muted slate blue (#506b82). Clean dark contour, bold helmet and shoulder shapes readable on a small phone.
